parameters.query: SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, NULL AS slug, t.code, t.name, t.sport, NULL AS logo_url, t.logo_key, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, t.area, t.city, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 1, JSON_ARRAY(CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' divisions'),   IF(MAX(v.entry_fee) = 0, 'Free entry', CONCAT(IF(MIN(v.entry_fee) = MAX(v.entry_fee), 'Entry ₹', 'Entry from ₹'), FORMAT(MIN(v.entry_fee), 0, 'en_IN')))),   JSON_ARRAY(CASE MIN(v.format) WHEN 'LEAGUE' THEN 'League' WHEN 'KNOCKOUT' THEN 'Knockout' ELSE 'Groups + knockout' END,   IF(MAX(v.entry_fee) > 0, CONCAT('Entry ₹', FORMAT(MAX(v.entry_fee), 0, 'en_IN')), 'Free entry'))) FROM tournament_divisions v WHERE v.tournament_id = t.id) AS tags, t.status FROM tournaments t WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.status IN ('REGISTRATION_OPEN', 'REGISTRATION_CLOSED', 'FIXTURES_READY', 'LIVE') AND t.end_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY t.start_date LIMIT 20; SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, slug, NULL AS code, name, sport, logo_url, logo_key, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, area, city, tags, status FROM featured_tournaments WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id
